description: Live departure or arrival board for a GB railway station, from National Rail's Darwin feed: booked time, expected time, actual time once reported, platform, operator and any delay or cancellation reason. An expected time equal to the booked one means no revision has been published, which usually means running to plan. A missing expected time is not a statement that the train is on time. Reasons are National Rail's own wording.

includeNonPassenger.description: Include empty stock, freight and staff trains.

station.description: Station name, CRS code (KGX) or TIPLOC.
